learning_objective: 🎯 Experience the hilarious and chaotic bond between a human and an unusual pet (an otter), and appreciate Carl Sandburg’s tiny, vivid poem about fog.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: After his dog died, the author (Maxwell) decides to keep an otter as a pet in Iraq. He gets an otter via two Arabs and names him 'Mijbil'. At first, Mijbil is aloof and indifferent, but soon becomes extremely playful, especially with water. Otters love water so much that Mijbil learns to turn on the bathroom tap by himself!

Taking Mijbil to London is a nightmare. British Airways refuses to fly animals, so he books another airline. Mijbil is packed in a box, but he tears the inner lining, cuts himself, and bleeds. On the plane, Mijbil escapes the box, causing passengers to scream (a woman screams 'A rat!'). A very kind air hostess helps Maxwell catch him.

In London, Mijbil invents his own games, like balancing a ping-pong ball on his belly. When walking on the streets, Londoners who have never seen an otter make wild guesses: 'Is it a baby seal?', 'A walrus?', 'A hippo?'. Finally, a laborer digging a hole asks the funniest question: 'Here, Mister—what is that supposed to be?'

A very short, brilliant 6-line poem. The poet compares the fog over a city to a cat. Just as a cat comes silently on soft padded feet, sits silently looking around, and then silently moves on, the fog arrives over the harbor and city, stays for a while, and then clears away quietly.

fun_activity.title: 🦦 The Animal Guessing Game
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you see a strange animal walking down the street with a leash. Londoners called Mijbil a beaver, a bear cub, a leopard, and a brontosaurus! People make wild guesses when they see something new. If you saw an Otter for the first time, what would you call it? A wet dog? A large squirrel?

exam_tips: 📌 Why is the air hostess called 'the very queen of her kind'? (Because instead of scolding Maxwell for the bloody box and the escaping otter, she was extremely polite, helpful, and allowed him to keep Mijbil on his knee).
📌 What characteristic of otters is heavily highlighted in the chapter? (Their absolute madness and love for playing with water).
📌 In the poem 'Fog', the entire poem is an extended metaphor. The fog's arrival, sitting, and leaving is exactly compared to the movements of a silent cat.
quick_recap: ⭐ The species of otter Maxwell had was unknown to science at the time, and was later named 'Maxwell's otter' (Lutrogale perspicillata maxwelli).
⭐ When Mijbil escaped on the plane, the author ended up covered in curry while diving to catch him.
⭐ The poem 'Fog' has no rhyme scheme; it is written in free verse.
